scope: Main React ProfilePanel continuations after unmount, using real writes on synthetic local accounts

before.accountDeletion: The real first-account DELETE completed server-side; its delayed response triggered /api/auth/sign-out after another teacher entered
before.profileSave: The real first-account PATCH completed server-side; its delayed response changed the next workspace document language from ru to kk

implementation: ProfilePanel lifecycle guard suppresses stale save, locale, refresh, error, sign-out and reload continuations after unmount; committed server writes are preserved

remoteCI.standaloneConclusion: cancelled while pending; superseded by the next commit

limits: This guards ProfilePanel after unmount; other asynchronous forms need separate review
A cookie change before canonical session observation still needs expected-owner mutation fencing
An already-dispatched server mutation is not rolled back
The later native-auth extension requires its own remote CI run; no public deployment was performed
